# Velmoria's anonymous benefactor

*One hundred and seventy-five years on, a mysterious bequest tests whether a republic can accept a gift without selling its soul*

LET THIS chapter pose a (felicitous) puzzle. One hundred and seventy-five years after the marshal fell, Velmoria received an extraordinary and (anomalous) bequest: an (anonymous) donor, dying without heirs, left the republic a (fabulous) fortune, set out in a (voluminous) testament—enough to transform the nation's schools, hospitals, and roads. It seemed a (miraculous), (fortuitous) windfall. But the gift came with conditions, and those conditions tested whether even a (virtuous) republic can accept (gratuitous) generosity without becoming (duplicitous) toward its own principles.

The fortune was vast beyond reckoning. It could fund a (numerous) host of public works, lift whole (populous) districts from want, and leave the republic (prosperous) for a generation. The temptation was (perilous) precisely because it left the republic so (desirous) of what it offered. Here was a chance to do (miraculous) good—to be (magnanimous) on a scale no budget could match. Only a (pusillanimous) or (callous) leader, it seemed, would refuse. And yet the conditions attached to the gift gave the more (meticulous) and (perspicacious) citizens pause.

The donor's terms were (ambiguous) and, on inspection, (insidious). The fortune would flow only if the republic agreed to certain "reforms"—a streamlining of oversight here, a (tenuous) loosening of accountability there, a (gratuitous) grant of (autonomous) power to a new foundation that the donor's executors would control. The conditions were (sinuous), (tortuous), (circuitous)—a (nebulous) web that, followed to its end, would create a private power (coterminous) with the state itself. The gift was (specious): a (fabulous) sum dangled to purchase a (perilous) concession.

Recall how the marshal had used money. He was (unscrupulous) and (gluttonous), a (rapacious) hoarder who treated the treasury as a trough for his (voluptuous) appetites. He bought loyalty with (gratuitous) largess and punished dissent with (callous) cruelty. His patronage was (duplicitous)—every gift a hook, every favor a chain. He made the (populous) districts dependent on his (capricious) generosity, then ruled them through their need. His was a (parlous), (iniquitous) economy of bribery, dressed in the (glamorous) language of national prosperity.

The republic, (chasten)ed by that memory, examined the (anonymous) bequest with (meticulous), (sedulous) care. A commission of (assiduous) auditors and (perspicacious) jurists studied the (voluminous) terms. They were neither (credulous) of the donor's (ostensible) generosity nor (timorous) before its scale. They asked the question that the marshal's reign had taught even the most (necessitous) citizen never to forget: what does the giver want in return? And the answer, traced through the (sinuous), (circuitous) clauses, was (portentous)—a slow, (insidious) capture of public power by private hands.

The debate was (vigorous) and, at times, (cantankerous). One faction, (desirous) of the (miraculous) good the money could do, argued that to refuse it would be (pusillanimous)—a (timorous), (callous) failure of nerve that would condemn the (necessitous) to needless want. Their case was not (fatuous); the good was real, the needs (numerous). But the opposing faction, more (perspicacious), warned that a gift which compromised the republic's (autonomous) self-rule was no gift at all. To accept the (gratuitous) fortune on (iniquitous) terms would be a (duplicitous) betrayal—prosperity purchased with the republic's soul.

The resolution was (felicitous) and (magnanimous) at once. The republic would not be (pusillanimous), but neither would it be (credulous). It accepted the bequest—but only after a (sedulous), (meticulous) renegotiation that stripped away the (insidious) conditions. The (anonymous) donor's executors, exposed to the (conspicuous) light of public scrutiny, found their (sinuous) scheme unworkable. The fortune would flow to the (populous) districts, the schools, the hospitals—but under the republic's own (autonomous) control, with no grant of private power, however (tenuous), no (circuitous) capture of the state. The good was kept; the poison was drained.

The donor's executors did not yield gracefully. They turned (querulous), then (slanderous), accusing the commission, in (libelous) screeds, of cold ingratitude toward a (magnanimous) benefactor. They spread a (scurrilous), (nebulous) rumor that the republic had spurned a (miraculous) gift out of (pompous) pride. But the public, (perspicacious) and (meticulous) after generations of vigilance, saw through the (duplicitous) (animus). The executors' (slanderous) campaign was (preposterous) on its face, and it found no audience in the (populous) districts. Their (insidious) scheme withered in the (conspicuous) daylight.

Beyond the (contentious) bequest, ordinary life kept its (salubrious) round. The (mountainous) hinterland was green; the (herbivorous) flocks grazed the high meadows; an (omnivorous) bear—no (carnivorous) menace—foraged the (deciduous) woods at the forest's edge. A botanist catalogued the (indigenous), (diaphanous)-petaled flowers of the valley; a chemist tested the (saliferous) springs and the (anhydrous), (nonporous) clay of the riverbank. At the market, an (odoriferous) cheese drew (numerous) buyers; a (dexterous), (ambidextrous) juggler delighted the children; a (sonorous) bell rang the (synchronous) hours. The air was free of any (cacophonous) discord—only the (mellifluous), (monotonous)-in-the-best-way rhythm of a free people's days.

The episode entered the national (annals) as a lesson in the (perils) of generosity. A republic, the historians wrote, is tested not only by what threatens it but by what tempts it—and a (gratuitous), (fabulous) gift can be as (insidious) as any (libelous) attack, if its (sinuous) conditions would compromise self-rule. The (virtuous) course is neither the (pusillanimous) refusal of all aid nor the (credulous) acceptance of every (specious) windfall, but the (meticulous), (sedulous) scrutiny that asks what the giver wants in return. To accept good on (iniquitous) terms is no virtue; to do good while preserving one's (autonomous) integrity is the harder, (felicitous) path.

So Velmoria, one hundred and seventy-five years free, learns that even generosity can be a (perilous) (vicissitude)—that a free people must be as (perspicacious) about gifts as about threats, as wary of the (mellifluous) benefactor as of the (cantankerous) tyrant. The marshal ruled by (gratuitous) largess that bought (callous) dependence; the (anonymous) donor offered a (fabulous) fortune that would have purchased the republic's (autonomous) soul. His country, a century and three-quarters past his fall, has chosen the (converse)—to accept good only on (virtuous) terms, to drain the (insidious) poison from every (specious) gift, and to keep, beneath all the (glamorous) temptations of wealth, the one (perspicacious), (incorruptible) truth whose worth no (fabulous) fortune can (surpass): that a free people's (autonomous) self-rule is not for sale, at any price, however (miraculous) the bribe.

quiz.question: anomalous ______
quiz.explanation: 异常的; 反常的, 异常的结果. The scientist investigated the anomalous result in the experiment. 科学家调查了实验中的异常结果。 | an->无，omal->规律（希腊homalos->平坦），anomalous->不符合规律的=异常的（cf. anomaly异常，normal正常，enormous巨大的） || 文化联想：中文“事出反常必有因”最适合帮助记忆 anomalous，可以说 **an anomalous result — “When one measurement is completely unlike all the others, the scientist treats it as an anomalous result and investigates why.”**

quiz.question: libelous _________
quiz.explanation: 诽谤的, 诽谤性声明. The newspaper retracted the libelous statement about the mayor. 报纸撤回了关于市长的诽谤性声明。 | libel->小册子（拉丁libellus->小书），libelous->以小册子诽谤的（cf. libel书面诽谤，slander口头诽谤，library图书馆） || 文化联想：中文“造谣诽谤”最适合帮助记忆 libelous，可以说 **a libelous statement — “Publishing a false accusation that damages someone’s reputation may amount to a libelous statement.”**

quiz.question: perilous _______
quiz.explanation: 危险的; 冒险的, 危险的旅程. The explorers embarked on a perilous journey across the desert. 探险家开始了穿越沙漠的危险旅程。 | peril->危险（拉丁periculum->试验/危险），perilous->充满危险的（cf. experience经验=经历危险，experiment实验，parlous危险的） || 文化联想：中国古代翻越蜀道的艰险最适合帮助记忆 perilous，可以说 **a perilous journey — “Crossing a steep mountain route in bad weather can become a perilous journey.”**

quiz.question: scurrilous ______
quiz.explanation: 恶意诽谤的; 下流的, 恶意诽谤的攻击. The politician faced a scurrilous attack from opponents. 这位政客面临来自对手的恶意诽谤攻击。 | scurr->小丑/弄臣（拉丁scurra），scurrilous->像小丑一样粗鄙辱骂的（cf. scurry仓皇，scurrilous language下流语言） || 文化联想：中文“恶意中伤、泼脏水”最适合帮助记忆 scurrilous，可以说 **a scurrilous attack — “A campaign that relies on crude insults and invented accusations is a scurrilous attack rather than fair criticism.”**

quiz.question: callous _________
quiz.explanation: 冷酷的; 无情的, 冷酷的漠视. His callous disregard for others' feelings hurt many people. 他对他人感受的冷酷漠视伤害了许多人。 | callus->老茧（拉丁），callous->长了老茧=麻木冷酷的（cf. callus老茧，callosity厚茧，cf. hard-hearted心肠硬的） || 文化联想：中文“麻木不仁”最适合帮助记忆 callous，可以说 **callous disregard — “Ignoring the suffering of injured people simply because helping is inconvenient shows callous disregard.”**

quiz.question: parlous _____
quiz.explanation: 危险的; 糟糕的, 危险的状态. The economy was in a parlous state after the crisis. 危机后经济处于危险的状态。 | parlous->perilous的古英语缩写，parlous->危险的（cf. perilous危险的，parlous times危险时期） || 文化联想：中文“岌岌可危”最适合帮助记忆 parlous，可以说 **a parlous state — “A company with almost no cash and large debts may be in a parlous state.”**

quiz.question: fabulous ______
quiz.explanation: 巨大的; 极好的, 巨额财富. The entrepreneur accumulated fabulous wealth through investments. 企业家通过投资积累了巨额财富。 | fabul->故事（拉丁fabula），fabulous->像故事里才有的=神话般的/极好的（cf. fable寓言，famous著名的，fame名声） || 文化联想：中文“富可敌国”最适合帮助记忆 fabulous，可以说 **fabulous wealth — “A business magnate whose fortune seems almost beyond imagination may possess fabulous wealth.”**

quiz.question: nebulous ____
quiz.explanation: 模糊的; 朦胧的, 模糊的想法. His plan was just a nebulous idea without clear details. 他的计划只是一个没有明确细节的模糊想法。 | nebul->云雾（拉丁nebula->星云），nebulous->像云雾一样模糊的（cf. nebula星云，Nevada内华达=雪山州） || 文化联想：中文“云里雾里、说不清楚”最适合帮助记忆 nebulous，可以说 **a nebulous idea — “A proposal with no clear goal, budget, or timeline remains only a nebulous idea.”**

quiz.question: bibulous _____
quiz.explanation: 嗜酒的, 嗜酒的人群. The bibulous crowd filled the tavern every night. 嗜酒的人群每晚都挤满了酒馆。 | bibul->饮（拉丁bibere->喝），bibulous->喜好饮酒的（cf. imbibe饮酒，Bible书=重要的书，bibliography书目） || 文化联想：传统酒席上一桌人频频劝酒的场景最适合帮助记忆 bibulous，可以说 **a bibulous crowd — “At an old-fashioned banquet, a bibulous crowd may keep raising cups and proposing one toast after another.”**

quiz.question: miraculous ________
quiz.explanation: 奇迹般的, 奇迹般的康复. The patient made a miraculous recovery from the illness. 患者从疾病中奇迹般地康复。 | miracul->奇迹（拉丁mirari->惊叹），miraculous->奇迹般的（cf. miracle奇迹，mirror镜子=令人惊叹的，admire钦佩） || 文化联想：中文“奇迹般康复”最适合帮助记忆 miraculous，可以说 **a miraculous recovery — “A patient who improves far faster than doctors expected may be described as making a miraculous recovery.”**

quiz.question: meticulous ________
quiz.explanation: 一丝不苟的; 细致的, 一丝不苟的规划. The project required meticulous planning and attention to detail. 该项目需要一丝不苟的规划和对细节的关注。 | metic->恐惧（拉丁metus），meticulous->因害怕出错而极度细心的（cf. timid胆小，mettle勇气，cf. perfectionist完美主义者） || 文化联想：中文“一丝不苟”最适合帮助记忆 meticulous，可以说 **meticulous planning — “A major construction project requires meticulous planning of cost, safety, timing, and materials.”**

quiz.question: credulous ______
quiz.explanation: 轻信的; 易受骗的, 轻信的公众. The scammer exploited the credulous public with false promises. 骗子用虚假承诺利用轻信的公众。 | cred->相信（拉丁credere），credulous->什么都信的=轻信的（cf. credit信用，incredible难以置信的，credo信条） || 文化联想：中文“轻信谣言、容易上当”最适合帮助记忆 credulous，可以说 **a credulous public — “A scam can spread quickly when a credulous public accepts dramatic promises without checking evidence.”**

quiz.question: sedulous _____
quiz.explanation: 勤勉的; 孜孜不倦的, 勤勉的学习. Through sedulous study, she mastered three languages. 通过勤勉的学习,她掌握了三种语言。 | sedulo->真诚用心（拉丁sedulo->不懈地），sedulous->勤勉不倦的（cf. assiduous勤勉的=坐在一旁不离开，cf. industrious） || 文化联想：中文“孜孜不倦”最适合帮助记忆 sedulous，可以说 **sedulous study — “Years of sedulous study can turn a beginner into a highly capable scholar.”**

quiz.question: populous ____
quiz.explanation: 人口稠密的, 人口稠密的城市. Tokyo is one of the worlds most populous city centers. 东京是世界上人口最稠密的城市中心之一。 | popul->人民（拉丁populus），populous->人口多的（cf. popular流行的，populate使有人口，depopulate使人口减少） || 文化联想：上海、深圳等人口密集大城市最适合帮助记忆 populous，可以说 **a populous city — “Shanghai is a populous city where millions of people share dense neighborhoods and extensive transit networks.”**

quiz.question: unscrupulous _______
quiz.explanation: 无道德原则的; 不择手段的, 不择手段的策略. The company used unscrupulous tactics to eliminate competitors. 公司使用不择手段的策略来消灭竞争对手。 | scrupul->小石子/顾虑，unscrupulous->不在乎顾虑的（cf. scruple顾虑，scrupulous谨慎的，unscrupulous=no scruples） || 文化联想：中文“不择手段”最适合帮助记忆 unscrupulous，可以说 **unscrupulous tactics — “A company that bribes officials or fabricates evidence is using unscrupulous tactics.”**

quiz.question: querulous ____
quiz.explanation: 抱怨的; 爱发牢骚的, 抱怨的语气. She answered in a querulous tone that annoyed everyone. 她用抱怨的语气回答,让每个人都很恼火。 | quer->抱怨（拉丁queri），querulous->总是抱怨的（cf. quarrel争吵，query疑问，querulous vs. quizzical疑惑的） || 文化联想：中文“满腹牢骚”最适合帮助记忆 querulous，可以说 **a querulous tone — “Someone who complains about every minor inconvenience may speak in a querulous tone.”**

quiz.question: garrulous ________
quiz.explanation: 唠叨的; 喋喋不休的, 唠叨的邻居. The garrulous neighbor talked for hours without pause. 唠叨的邻居不停地说了几个小时。 | garr->喋喋不休（拉丁garrire->喋喋不休），garrulous->话多唠叨的（cf. loquacious健谈，voluble流利，garrulous更偏负面） || 文化联想：中文“唠唠叨叨说个不停”最适合帮助记忆 garrulous，可以说 **a garrulous neighbor — “A garrulous neighbor may turn a two-minute greeting into an hour-long conversation.”**

quiz.question: pusillanimous ________
quiz.explanation: 胆小的; 懦弱的, 懦弱的回应. His pusillanimous response disappointed his supporters. 他懦弱的回应让支持者失望。 | pusill->很小（拉丁pusillus->极小），anim->精神，pusillanimous->精神极其渺小的=胆小的（cf. magnanimous宽宏大量=大精神） || 文化联想：中文“畏首畏尾”最适合帮助记忆 pusillanimous，可以说 **a pusillanimous response — “A leader who avoids every difficult decision out of fear may give a pusillanimous response.”**

quiz.question: magnanimous _______
quiz.explanation: 宽宏大量的; 慷慨的, 宽宏大量的姿态. The victor made a magnanimous gesture toward the defeated. 胜利者向失败者做出了宽宏大量的姿态。 | magn->大，anim->精神，magnanimous->精神伟大的=宽宏大量的（cf. magnify放大，animate使有活力，unanimousone spirit） || 文化联想：中文“宰相肚里能撑船”最适合帮助记忆 magnanimous，可以说 **a magnanimous gesture — “A winner who praises the defeated opponent and shares credit shows a magnanimous gesture—很像‘宰相肚里能撑船’的气度.”**

quiz.question: unanimous ____
quiz.explanation: 一致的; 全体同意的, 一致投票. The committee reached a unanimous vote on the proposal. 委员会对该提案达成了一致投票。 | un->一，anim->精神，unanimous->只有一个声音=全体同意的（cf. animate使活跃，magnanimous宽宏的，pusillanimous胆小） || 文化联想：中文“全票通过”最适合帮助记忆 unanimous，可以说 **a unanimous vote — “If every member supports the proposal, the committee reaches a unanimous vote.”**

quiz.question: autonomous ______
quiz.explanation: 自治的; 自主的, 自治区. The autonomous region has its own local government. 自治区有自己的地方政府。 | auto->自己，nom->法律（希腊nomos），autonomous->自己制定法律的=自治的（cf. autonomy自治，astronomy天文=星的法则） || 文化联想：中国语境里的“自治区”最适合帮助记忆 autonomous，可以说 **an autonomous region — “The phrase autonomous region helps learners remember autonomous as meaning having a degree of self-government.”**

quiz.question: anonymous _____
quiz.explanation: 匿名的; 无名的, 匿名捐赠者. An anonymous donor contributed millions to the charity. 一位匿名捐赠者向慈善机构捐赠了数百万。 | an->无，onym->名字（希腊），anonymous->没有名字的=匿名的（cf. synonym同义词，antonym反义词，pseudonym笔名） || 文化联想：中文“匿名捐款”最适合帮助记忆 anonymous，可以说 **an anonymous donor — “An anonymous donor may contribute a large sum without allowing the charity to publish the donor’s name.”**

quiz.question: diaphanous ______
quiz.explanation: 透明的; 轻薄的, 透明的织物. She wore a dress made of diaphanous fabric. 她穿着一件由透明织物制成的连衣裙。 | dia->穿过，phan->显现（希腊phainein），diaphanous->光能穿过的=透明的（cf. phenomenon现象，phantom幽灵，epiphany顿悟） || 文化联想：中国古装剧里轻薄半透明的纱衣最适合帮助记忆 diaphanous，可以说 **diaphanous fabric — “A costume designer may use diaphanous fabric to create a light, floating outer robe.”**

quiz.question: indigenous _______
quiz.explanation: 本土的; 土著的, 土著民族. Indigenous peoples have lived here for thousands of years. 土著民族在这里生活了数千年。 | indig->在内（拉丁indigena），indigenous->天生就在里面的=本土的（cf. indigen本土居民，indigent贫困的，endogenous内生的） || 文化联想：中国学生世界史和人类学课程里学习各地原住民族最适合帮助记忆 indigenous，可以说 **indigenous peoples — “In anthropology, students may study how indigenous peoples preserve languages, customs, and land-based traditions.”**

quiz.question: ravenous ________
quiz.explanation: 贪婪的; 饥饿的, 贪婪的食欲. After hiking all day, he had a ravenous appetite. 徒步一整天后,他有贪婪的食欲。 | raven->乌鸦/掠夺（古法语ravine->掠夺），ravenous->像乌鸦一样贪婪饥饿的（cf. rapacious贪婪，ravine峡谷=被水侵蚀的） || 文化联想：徒步一天后“饿得前胸贴后背”最适合帮助记忆 ravenous，可以说 **a ravenous appetite — “After hiking all day without lunch, a traveler may return with a ravenous appetite.”**

quiz.question: villainous ____
quiz.explanation: 恶棍的; 邪恶的, 邪恶的行为. The criminal committed a villainous deed that shocked everyone. 罪犯犯下了震惊所有人的邪恶行为。 | villain->农奴/恶棍（古法语vilain->乡下人），villainous->恶棍般邪恶的（cf. villa别墅，village村庄，villain原指乡下粗人） || 文化联想：中文“恶贯满盈的坏事”最适合帮助记忆 villainous，可以说 **a villainous deed — “Stealing disaster-relief money from vulnerable families would be a villainous deed.”**

quiz.question: mountainous _______
quiz.explanation: 多山的, 多山的地形. The rescue team navigated the mountainous terrain carefully. 救援队小心地穿越多山的地形。 | mountain->山（古法语montaigne），mountainous->充满山地的=多山的（cf. mount攀登，surmount克服，paramount最重要的） || 文化联想：川藏公路或横断山区最适合帮助记忆 mountainous，可以说 **mountainous terrain — “Rescue teams in western China may have to cross difficult mountainous terrain with steep slopes and deep valleys.”**

quiz.question: tendinous ______
quiz.explanation: 腱的, 肌腱损伤. The athlete suffered a tendinous injury during training. 运动员在训练中遭受了肌腱损伤。 | tendin->腱（拉丁tendere->伸展），tendinous->肌腱的（cf. tendon肌腱，tenacious顽强，tender温柔/投标） || 文化联想：运动员跟腱拉伤最适合帮助记忆 tendinous，可以说 **a tendinous injury — “A runner who suddenly feels sharp pain near the Achilles tendon may have a tendinous injury.”**

quiz.question: vicissitudinous ____
quiz.explanation: 变化无常的; 多灾多难的, 变化无常的生活. He led a vicissitudinous life full of ups and downs. 他过着充满起起落落的变化无常的生活。 | vicissit->交替变化（拉丁vicis->轮换），vicissitudinous->充满变化的（cf. vice反面，vicarious替代的，vicissitude沧桑） || 文化联想：中文“人生起起落落、历尽沧桑”最适合帮助记忆 vicissitudinous，可以说 **a vicissitudinous life — “A person who experiences war, migration, success, and repeated loss may lead a vicissitudinous life.”**

quiz.question: heinous _____
quiz.explanation: 极恶的; 令人发指的, 令人发指的罪行. The judge sentenced the perpetrator of the heinous crime. 法官对令人发指的罪行的犯罪者进行了判决。 | hain->憎恨（古法语haineus->令人憎恨），heinous->令人憎恨的=极其邪恶的（cf. hate憎恨，heinousness极恶） || 文化联想：中文“令人发指的罪行”最适合帮助记忆 heinous，可以说 **a heinous crime — “A deliberate act of extreme cruelty against innocent people may be condemned as a heinous crime.”**

quiz.question: coterminous _______
quiz.explanation: 毗连的; 同时发生的, 毗连的边界. The two countries share coterminous borders. 这两个国家有毗连的边界。 | co->共同，termin->边界（拉丁terminus），coterminous->共享边界的=毗连的（cf. terminate终止，terminal终端，terminus终点） || 文化联想：中俄边界等相接边界的地理概念可帮助记忆 coterminous，可以说 **coterminous borders — “Two administrative areas whose boundaries coincide along the same line have coterminous borders.”**

quiz.question: voluminous _____
quiz.explanation: 大量的; 卷帙浩繁的, 大量的笔记. The historian left behind voluminous notes on the period. 历史学家留下了关于那个时期的大量笔记。 | volum->卷（拉丁volumen->卷轴），voluminous->像卷轴一样多的=大量的（cf. volume卷/音量，revolve旋转，evolve进化） || 文化联想：中文“笔记多得卷帙浩繁”最适合帮助记忆 voluminous，可以说 **voluminous notes — “A historian who studies one subject for decades may leave behind voluminous notes filling many boxes.”**

quiz.question: numinous ________
quiz.explanation: 神圣的; 超自然的, 神圣的存在. The ancient temple had a numinous presence. 古老的寺庙有一种神圣的存在感。 | numen->神力（拉丁），numinous->有神圣力量的（cf. numen神明意志，innumerable无数的，numeral数字=神定的数量） || 文化联想：中国古寺里肃静、庄严、仿佛带有神圣感的氛围最适合帮助记忆 numinous，可以说 **a numinous presence — “An ancient mountain temple at dawn may seem to have a numinous presence that inspires awe.”**

quiz.question: cacophonous _____
quiz.explanation: 刺耳的; 不和谐的, 嘈杂的人群. The cacophonous crowd made it impossible to hear. 嘈杂的人群使人无法听清。 | cac->坏（希腊kakos），phon->声音，cacophonous->声音难听的=刺耳的（cf. euphonious悦耳的，symphony交响乐，cacophony噪音） || 文化联想：春节庙会里锣鼓、人声、广播混在一起的嘈杂声最适合帮助记忆 cacophonous，可以说 **a cacophonous crowd — “At a crowded festival, drums, loudspeakers, vendors, and shouting visitors may create a cacophonous scene.”**

quiz.question: synchronous ______
quiz.explanation: 同步的; 同时发生的, 同步时钟. The synchronous clocks displayed the same time exactly. 同步时钟准确显示相同的时间。 | syn->共同，chron->时间（希腊），synchronous->同时间的=同步的（cf. chronicle年代记，chronic慢性的，anachronism时代错误） || 文化联想：中国高铁站大厅里统一校时的电子钟最适合帮助记忆 synchronous，可以说 **synchronous clocks — “The clocks across a railway station must remain synchronous so passengers see the same time everywhere.”**

quiz.question: monotonous ____
quiz.explanation: 单调的; 乏味的, 单调的语气. His monotonous tone put the audience to sleep. 他单调的语气让观众昏昏欲睡。 | mono->单一，ton->声音（希腊），monotonous->只有单一声调的=单调的（cf. monotone单调，monologue独白，monopoly垄断） || 文化联想：中文“念稿像和尚念经一样单调”最适合帮助记忆 monotonous，可以说 **a monotonous tone — “Reading an entire lecture in the same pitch and rhythm creates a monotonous tone.”**

quiz.question: gluttonous _____
quiz.explanation: 暴食的; 贪吃的, 暴食的食客. The gluttonous eater consumed an enormous amount. 暴食的食客吃了大量食物。 | glutton->贪吃者（拉丁gluttire->吞咽），gluttonous->暴食的（cf. gulp大口吞咽，swallow吞，gluttony暴食=七宗罪之一） || 文化联想：中文“暴饮暴食”最适合帮助记忆 gluttonous，可以说 **a gluttonous eater — “Someone who keeps eating far beyond hunger at a banquet may look like a gluttonous eater.”**

quiz.question: pompous ______
quiz.explanation: 自大的; 浮夸的, 浮夸的演讲. His pompous speech failed to impress the audience. 他浮夸的演讲未能打动观众。 | pomp->盛大游行（希腊pompe），pompous->喜欢大肆排场的=自大浮夸的（cf. pomp排场，pomposity自大，pompon绒球） || 文化联想：中文“官腔十足、浮夸自大”最适合帮助记忆 pompous，可以说 **a pompous speech — “A speech packed with grand titles and self-praise may sound pompous rather than impressive.”**

quiz.question: acarpous _____
quiz.explanation: 不结果实的, 不结果实的植物. The acarpous plant produces only flowers, no fruit. 不结果实的植物只开花不结果。 | a->无，carp->果实（希腊karpos），acarpous->无果实的（cf. carpel心皮，pericarp果皮，cf. Carpe Diem及时行乐） || 文化联想：中文“只开花不结果”最适合帮助记忆 acarpous，可以说 **an acarpous plant — “A plant that produces flowers year after year but never forms fruit is an acarpous plant.”**

quiz.question: barbarous ___
quiz.explanation: 野蛮的; 残暴的, 野蛮的行为. The soldiers committed barbarous act during the war. 士兵在战争期间犯下了野蛮的行为。 | barbaros->外国人（希腊，模仿外国人说话声"bar bar"），barbarous->像野蛮外族的（cf. barbarian野蛮人，barb倒钩） || 文化联想：中文“野蛮残暴”最适合帮助记忆 barbarous，可以说 **a barbarous act — “Deliberately harming defenseless civilians is a barbarous act.”**

quiz.question: scabrous _______
quiz.explanation: 粗糙的; 猥亵的, 粗糙的表面. The old wood had a scabrous surface covered in splinters. 旧木头有一个布满碎片的粗糙表面。 | scab->结痂（拉丁scabere->刮），scabrous->表面粗糙如痂的（cf. scab罢工破坏者，scabies疥疮，rough粗糙） || 文化联想：老木板毛刺很多、摸起来粗糙最适合帮助记忆 scabrous，可以说 **a scabrous surface — “An untreated old wooden board may have a scabrous surface covered with splinters.”**

quiz.question: anhydrous ____
quiz.explanation: 无水的, 无水盐. The chemist used anhydrous salt in the experiment. 化学家在实验中使用了无水盐。 | an->无，hydr->水（希腊），anhydrous->不含水的（cf. hydrate水合物，dehydrate脱水，hydrogen氢=产生水的元素） || 文化联想：中国化学实验室里的无水盐最适合帮助记忆 anhydrous，可以说 **anhydrous salt — “A chemist may keep an anhydrous salt sealed because it readily absorbs moisture from the air.”**

quiz.question: slanderous _____
quiz.explanation: 诽谤的; 中伤的, 诽谤性谣言. The victim sued over the slanderous rumor spread online. 受害者因网上传播的诽谤性谣言提起诉讼。 | slander->口头诽谤（古法语esclandre->丑闻），slanderous->诽谤的（cf. scandal丑闻，libelous书面诽谤，slander口头诽谤） || 文化联想：中文“恶意造谣中伤”最适合帮助记忆 slanderous，可以说 **a slanderous rumor — “Inventing a damaging story about someone and spreading it by word of mouth creates a slanderous rumor.”**

quiz.question: ponderous _____
quiz.explanation: 笨重的; 沉闷的, 沉闷的散文. The authors ponderous prose made reading difficult. 作者沉闷的散文使阅读变得困难。 | ponder->称重/思考（拉丁ponderare），ponderous->沉重难以移动的（cf. ponder思考，pound磅=重量，preponderant占优势的） || 文化联想：中文“文章又臭又长、读起来沉重”最适合帮助记忆 ponderous，可以说 **ponderous prose — “An essay filled with long sentences and unnecessary abstractions may become ponderous prose.”**

quiz.question: saliferous _______
quiz.explanation: 含盐的, 含盐矿床. Miners discovered a large saliferous deposit underground. 矿工在地下发现了一个大型含盐矿床。 | sal->盐（拉丁sal），fer->携带，saliferous->携带盐分的=含盐的（cf. salary工资=古代用盐支付，salad沙拉=加盐的蔬菜） || 文化联想：青海、柴达木等盐湖和含盐矿层最适合帮助记忆 saliferous，可以说 **a saliferous deposit — “A geological survey may discover a saliferous deposit containing large amounts of natural salts.”**

quiz.question: odoriferous ____
quiz.explanation: 有气味的; 芳香的, 芳香的草药. The garden grew various odoriferous herb species. 花园种植了各种芳香的草药。 | odor->气味（拉丁），fer->携带，odoriferous->散发气味的=芳香的（cf. odor气味，deodorant除臭剂，olfaction嗅觉） || 文化联想：中国药草园里薄荷、藿香等气味明显的植物最适合帮助记忆 odoriferous，可以说 **an odoriferous herb — “Mint is an odoriferous herb that releases a strong aroma when its leaves are crushed.”**

quiz.question: cantankerous ___ ___
quiz.explanation: 脾气坏的; 爱争吵的, 脾气坏的老人. The cantankerous old man complained about everything. 脾气坏的老人对每件事都抱怨。 | cantankerous->喜争吵（来源不明，可能来自conteck->争吵），cantankerous->脾气暴躁爱吵架的（cf. contentious有争议的） || 文化联想：中文“脾气又臭又硬的老头”最适合帮助记忆 cantankerous，可以说 **a cantankerous old man — “A neighbor who argues about parking, noise, weather, and almost everything else may become known as a cantankerous old man.”**

quiz.question: numerous ________
quiz.explanation: 许多的; 大量的, 许多例子. The textbook provides numerous examples of the concept. 教科书提供了该概念的许多例子。 | numer->数（拉丁numerus），numerous->数量多的（cf. number数字，enumerate列举，innumerable无数的） || 文化联想：中文“举不胜举”最适合帮助记忆 numerous，可以说 **numerous examples — “A teacher explaining a familiar grammar rule can usually provide numerous examples.”**

quiz.question: prosperous ___
quiz.explanation: 繁荣的; 兴旺的, 繁荣时代. The country enjoyed a prosperous era of growth. 该国享受了一个繁荣的增长时代。 | pro->向前，sper->希望（拉丁sperare），prosperous->朝希望的方向走=繁荣的（cf. despair绝望，prosper繁荣，prosperity繁荣） || 文化联想：唐代“开元盛世”的繁荣景象最适合帮助记忆 prosperous，可以说 **a prosperous era — “A period of stable government, trade, population growth, and cultural activity may be remembered as a prosperous era.”**

quiz.question: preposterous ____
quiz.explanation: 荒谬的; 可笑的, 荒谬的想法. His plan was a preposterous idea that no one supported. 他的计划是一个没人支持的荒谬想法。 | pre->前，post->后，preposterous->把前面的放后面=本末倒置=荒谬的（cf. preposition前置词，posterior后部，前后颠倒） || 文化联想：中文“本末倒置、荒唐可笑”最适合帮助记忆 preposterous，可以说 **a preposterous idea — “Spending more to repair a broken chair than to buy a new one can become a preposterous idea.”**

quiz.question: dexterous _____
quiz.explanation: 灵巧的; 熟练的, 灵巧的双手. The surgeons dexterous hands performed the delicate operation. 外科医生灵巧的双手进行了精细的手术。 | dexter->右手（拉丁，右手被认为灵巧），dexterous->右手般灵巧的（cf. ambidextrous两手均灵，sinister左/邪恶，dexterity灵巧） || 文化联想：苏绣工匠灵巧的双手最适合帮助记忆 dexterous，可以说 **dexterous hands — “A Suzhou embroiderer needs dexterous hands to split silk threads and place tiny stitches precisely.”**

quiz.question: desirous __
quiz.explanation: 渴望的; 想要的, 渴望. She was desirous of achieving success in her career. 她渴望在事业上取得成功。 | desir->渴望（拉丁desiderare->思念星星），desirous->充满渴望的（cf. desire渴望，desiderate渴望，consider考虑=与星星同在） || 文化联想：中文“渴望成功”最适合帮助记忆 desirous，可以说 **desirous of success — “A young entrepreneur may be desirous of success but still need patience and discipline.”**

quiz.question: chivalrous ______
quiz.explanation: 侠义的; 有骑士风度的, 侠义的骑士. The chivalrous knight protected the innocent. 侠义的骑士保护无辜者。 | cheval->马（法语），chivalrous->骑马的=有骑士风度的（cf. cavalry骑兵，cavalier骑士/轻慢的，chivalry骑士精神） || 文化联想：chivalrous 是西方骑士精神，可用中国学生把它与“侠义”作功能类比来记忆，但二者并不相同，可以说 **a chivalrous knight — “A Chinese student may compare a chivalrous knight with a侠客 while remembering that the traditions are historically different.”**

quiz.question: vigorous ______
quiz.explanation: 有力的; 精力充沛的, 激烈的辩论. The candidates engaged in vigorous debate on stage. 候选人在台上进行了激烈的辩论。 | vigor->活力（拉丁vigor），vigorous->充满活力的（cf. vigor活力，invigorate使活跃，vigil守夜=保持活跃） || 文化联想：中文“针锋相对但有理有据的激烈辩论”最适合帮助记忆 vigorous，可以说 **a vigorous debate — “A university forum may host a vigorous debate in which both sides challenge each other with evidence.”**

quiz.question: valorous ____
quiz.explanation: 英勇的; 勇敢的, 英勇的行为. The soldier performed a valorous deed in battle. 士兵在战斗中做出了英勇的行为。 | valor->勇气（拉丁valere->强壮），valorous->有勇气的=英勇的（cf. valor英勇，valid有效，value价值，valiant勇敢的） || 文化联想：中文“英勇无畏”最适合帮助记忆 valorous，可以说 **a valorous deed — “A firefighter who enters a dangerous building to rescue trapped people performs a valorous deed.”**

quiz.question: dolorous ____
quiz.explanation: 悲伤的; 令人痛苦的, 悲伤的消息. The family received dolorous news about their father. 家人收到了关于父亲的悲伤消息。 | dolor->痛苦（拉丁dolor），dolorous->充满痛苦的（cf. doleful悲伤的，condolences哀悼，dolor痛苦） || 文化联想：中文“噩耗”最适合帮助记忆 dolorous，可以说 **dolorous news — “A family may fall silent after receiving dolorous news about the death of a loved one.”**

quiz.question: glamorous ____
quiz.explanation: 迷人的; 富有魅力的, 迷人的生活. The actress lived a glamorous life in Hollywood. 这位女演员在好莱坞过着迷人的生活。 | glamour->魔法（苏格兰语grammar的变体，中世纪知识=魔法），glamorous->有魔力迷人的（cf. grammar语法，glamour魔法/魅力） || 文化联想：上海滩电影里霓虹、礼服、豪车营造出的华丽生活最适合帮助记忆 glamorous，可以说 **a glamorous life — “A celebrity may appear to live a glamorous life filled with red carpets, luxury hotels, and constant attention.”**

quiz.question: timorous ______
quiz.explanation: 胆怯的; 胆小的, 胆怯的一瞥. She cast a timorous glance at the intimidating figure. 她向那个令人生畏的人物投去胆怯的一瞥。 | timor->恐惧（拉丁timere），timorous->充满恐惧的=胆怯的（cf. timid胆小，intimidate恐吓，Timor帝汶岛=令人恐惧的） || 文化联想：中文“怯生生地看了一眼”最适合帮助记忆 timorous，可以说 **a timorous glance — “A shy child entering a new classroom may cast a timorous glance at the unfamiliar faces.”**

quiz.question: sonorous _____
quiz.explanation: 洪亮的; 响亮的, 洪亮的声音. The speakers sonorous voice filled the auditorium. 演讲者洪亮的声音充满了礼堂。 | sonor->声音（拉丁sonare），sonorous->声音洪亮的（cf. sonic声音的，resonant共鸣的，sound声音，sonar声呐） || 文化联想：寺庙大钟或大型礼堂里低沉洪亮的声音最适合帮助记忆 sonorous，可以说 **a sonorous voice — “A trained speaker with a deep, resonant voice may fill a large hall with a sonorous voice.”**

quiz.question: porous ____
quiz.explanation: 多孔的; 能渗透的, 多孔岩石. Water easily flows through porous rock formations. 水很容易流过多孔岩石层。 | por->孔（拉丁porus），porous->多孔的（cf. pore毛孔，porosityI孔隙率，impervious不可渗透的） || 文化联想：桂林喀斯特地区可渗水石灰岩最适合帮助记忆 porous，可以说 **porous rock — “Rainwater can seep through porous rock and gradually form underground caves.”**

quiz.question: vaporous ____
quiz.explanation: 模糊的; 空洞的, 模糊的想法. His plan was just a vaporous idea with no substance. 他的计划只是一个没有实质内容的模糊想法。 | vapor->蒸气（拉丁vapor），vaporous->像蒸气一样飘渺的=空洞的（cf. evaporate蒸发，vaporize气化，vapor trail飞机云迹） || 文化联想：中文“像烟一样飘忽、没有实质”最适合帮助记忆 vaporous，可以说 **a vaporous idea — “A proposal with inspiring words but no budget, method, or evidence may be only a vaporous idea.”**

quiz.question: nonporous _______
quiz.explanation: 无孔的; 不透水的, 无孔表面. The countertop has a nonporous surface that resists stains. 台面有一个抗污渍的无孔表面。 | non->无，por->孔，nonporous->没有孔的（cf. porous多孔，impervious不透水，cf. sealed surface密封表面） || 文化联想：中国厨房石英石或玻璃台面的致密表面最适合帮助记忆 nonporous，可以说 **a nonporous surface — “A sealed countertop has a nonporous surface that resists water and stains.”**

quiz.question: herbivorous ____
quiz.explanation: 食草的, 食草性饮食. The elephant follows a herbivorous diet of plants. 大象遵循植物的食草性饮食。 | herb->草，vor->吃（拉丁vorare），herbivorous->吃草的（cf. carnivorous食肉，omnivorous杂食，voracious贪吃的） || 文化联想：大熊猫吃竹子最适合帮助记忆 herbivorous，可以说 **a herbivorous diet — “The giant panda is famous for a largely herbivorous diet dominated by bamboo.”**

quiz.question: omnivorous ____
quiz.explanation: 杂食的, 杂食性饮食. Bears maintain an omnivorous diet of plants and meat. 熊保持植物和肉类的杂食性饮食。 | omni->全部，vor->吃，omnivorous->什么都吃的（cf. omnipotent全能，omniscient全知，omnibus公共汽车=载所有人） || 文化联想：中国黑熊既吃植物也吃动物最适合帮助记忆 omnivorous，可以说 **an omnivorous diet — “A bear may follow an omnivorous diet that includes berries, roots, insects, and small animals.”**

quiz.question: carnivorous _____
quiz.explanation: 食肉的, 食肉植物. The Venus flytrap is a carnivorous plant that eats insects. 捕蝇草是一种吃昆虫的食肉植物。 | carn->肉（拉丁caro），vor->吃，carnivorous->吃肉的（cf. carnage屠杀，carnival狂欢节=吃肉前的节日，incarnate肉身的） || 文化联想：植物园里的猪笼草和捕蝇草最适合帮助记忆 carnivorous，可以说 **a carnivorous plant — “A Venus flytrap is a carnivorous plant that captures insects to supplement nutrients.”**

quiz.question: ferrous _____
quiz.explanation: 含铁的, 含铁金属. Steel is a ferrous metal alloy containing iron. 钢是一种含铁的金属合金。 | ferr->铁（拉丁ferrum），ferrous->含铁的（cf. ferric铁的，ferrite铁素体，nonferrous有色金属=非铁金属） || 文化联想：中国钢铁工业最适合帮助记忆 ferrous，可以说 **a ferrous metal — “Steel is a ferrous metal because iron is one of its principal components.”**

quiz.question: lustrous ____
quiz.explanation: 有光泽的; 光亮的, 有光泽的头发. She maintained lustrous hair through careful grooming. 她通过精心打理保持头发有光泽。 | lustr->发光（拉丁lustrare），lustrous->发光的=有光泽的（cf. luster光泽，illustrious杰出的=被照亮的，lackluster无光泽） || 文化联想：中文“乌黑亮丽、有光泽的头发”最适合帮助记忆 lustrous，可以说 **lustrous hair — “Healthy hair that reflects light smoothly can appear dark and lustrous.”**

quiz.question: ambidextrous _____
quiz.explanation: 双手都灵巧的, 双手灵巧的技能. His ambidextrous skill allowed him to write with either hand. 他双手灵巧的技能使他可以用任何一只手写字。 | ambi->两者，dexter->右手，ambidextrous->两手都像右手一样灵巧的（cf. dexterous灵巧，sinister左/邪恶） || 文化联想：中国书法爱好者若左右手都能写字最适合帮助记忆 ambidextrous，可以说 **ambidextrous skill — “A calligrapher who can control a brush equally well with either hand shows unusual ambidextrous skill.”**

quiz.question: felicitous ______
quiz.explanation: 恰当的; 得体的, 恰当的措辞. The writer chose a felicitous phrase to express the idea. 作家选择了一个恰当的措辞来表达这个想法。 | felix->幸运/快乐（拉丁），felicitous->恰到好处带来愉悦的（cf. felicity幸福，Felix姓名，infelicitous不恰当的） || 文化联想：中文“这句话说得恰到好处”最适合帮助记忆 felicitous，可以说 **a felicitous phrase — “A concise expression that captures an idea perfectly can be a felicitous phrase.”**

quiz.question: infelicitous ______
quiz.explanation: 不恰当的; 不得体的, 不恰当的评论. His infelicitous remark offended several guests. 他不恰当的评论冒犯了几位客人。 | in->否定，felix->幸运，infelicitous->不恰当带来不快的（cf. felicitous恰当的，infelicity不幸/不恰当） || 文化联想：中文“说话不合时宜”最适合帮助记忆 infelicitous，可以说 **an infelicitous remark — “Making a joke during a solemn memorial would be an infelicitous remark.”**

quiz.question: solicitous ____
quiz.explanation: 关心的; 体贴的, 体贴的照顾. The nurse provided solicitous care to all patients. 护士为所有病人提供了体贴的照顾。 | sol->全部，cit->激动（拉丁），solicitous->全心牵挂的=体贴关心的（cf. solicit请求，solicitor律师，solicitous关怀备至） || 文化联想：中文“关怀备至”最适合帮助记忆 solicitous，可以说 **solicitous care — “A nurse who repeatedly checks a patient’s comfort and needs provides solicitous care.”**

quiz.question: duplicitous _______
quiz.explanation: 欺骗的; 两面派的, 欺骗的行为. His duplicitous conduct betrayed his friends trust. 他欺骗的行为背叛了朋友的信任。 | duplic->两层（拉丁duplex->双重），duplicitous->两面三刀的（cf. duplicate复制，duplex双重的，duplicity两面派） || 文化联想：中文“两面三刀”最适合帮助记忆 duplicitous，可以说 **duplicitous conduct — “Pretending to support a colleague while secretly undermining that person is duplicitous conduct.”**

quiz.question: necessitous ______
quiz.explanation: 贫困的; 贫穷的, 贫困的家庭. The charity helps necessitous family in need. 慈善机构帮助需要帮助的贫困家庭。 | necess->必需（拉丁necesse），necessitous->缺乏必需品的=贫困的（cf. necessary必要的，necessity必需品，necesse不可避免） || 文化联想：中文“家境贫寒、缺衣少食”最适合帮助记忆 necessitous，可以说 **a necessitous family — “A charity may provide food and school supplies to a necessitous family that cannot afford basic needs.”**

quiz.question: circuitous _____
quiz.explanation: 迂回的; 绕道的, 迂回的路线. They took a circuitous route to avoid the traffic jam. 他们走了一条迂回的路线以避开交通堵塞。 | circuit->绕圈（拉丁circuire->绕行），circuitous->绕道而行的=迂回的（cf. circle圆，circuit巡回，circumference周长） || 文化联想：中文“绕远路”最适合帮助记忆 circuitous，可以说 **a circuitous route — “A mountain road blocked by a landslide may force drivers to take a circuitous route through several villages.”**

quiz.question: iniquitous ______
quiz.explanation: 不公正的; 邪恶的, 不公正的政策. The government abolished the iniquitous policy. 政府废除了不公正的政策。 | in->否定，equ->平等（拉丁aequus），iniquitous->不平等不公正的（cf. equal平等，equity公平，inequity不公平，iniquity邪恶） || 文化联想：中文“极不公平的政策”最适合帮助记忆 iniquitous，可以说 **an iniquitous policy — “A rule that gives one group privileges while deliberately denying basic rights to another may be an iniquitous policy.”**

quiz.question: gratuitous ______
quiz.explanation: 无端的; 无理由的, 无端的侮辱. His gratuitous insult was completely uncalled for. 他无端的侮辱完全是无缘无故的。 | gratu->感激/免费（拉丁gratia->恩惠），gratuitous->无需付出的=无偿的/无端的（cf. gratitude感激，gratuity小费，gratis免费） || 文化联想：中文“无缘无故出口伤人”最适合帮助记忆 gratuitous，可以说 **a gratuitous insult — “Calling someone stupid during an unrelated discussion is a gratuitous insult because it serves no purpose.”**

quiz.question: fortuitous _________
quiz.explanation: 偶然的; 意外的, 偶然的相遇. Their fortuitous encounter led to a lasting friendship. 他们偶然的相遇导致了持久的友谊。 | fortuit->偶然（拉丁fortuna->命运），fortuitous->命运偶然安排的（cf. fortune命运，fortunate幸运的，fortuitous偶然但通常是好的） || 文化联想：中文“偶然相遇却成就一段缘分”最适合帮助记忆 fortuitous，可以说 **a fortuitous encounter — “Two researchers who meet by chance on a train may have a fortuitous encounter that later leads to collaboration.”**

quiz.question: momentous ________
quiz.explanation: 重大的; 重要的, 重大的决定. The board made a momentous decision to merge. 董事会做出了合并的重大决定。 | moment->瞬间/重要（拉丁momentum），momentous->具有巨大重量/重要性的（cf. moment时刻，momentum动量，momentary短暂的） || 文化联想：中文“人生重大抉择”最适合帮助记忆 momentous，可以说 **a momentous decision — “Choosing whether to move to another country can be a momentous decision that changes an entire family’s future.”**

quiz.question: portentous ____
quiz.explanation: 预兆的; 不祥的, 不祥的征兆. Dark clouds were a portentous sign of the coming storm. 乌云是即将来临的暴风雨的不祥征兆。 | portent->预兆（拉丁portendere->预示），portentous->充满不祥预兆的（cf. portent凶兆，portend预示，omen征兆） || 文化联想：中文“山雨欲来风满楼”最适合帮助记忆 portentous，可以说 **a portentous sign — “Darkening skies and a sudden drop in pressure can feel like a portentous sign that a severe storm is coming.”**

quiz.question: riotous _____
quiz.explanation: 骚乱的; 喧闹的, 骚乱的人群. Police dispersed the riotous crowd with tear gas. 警察用催泪瓦斯驱散了骚乱的人群。 | riot->骚乱（古法语riote->争吵），riotous->骚乱的/狂欢的（cf. riot暴乱，riotous living放荡生活，riotous applause热烈掌声） || 文化联想：中文“闹哄哄、几乎失控的人群”最适合帮助记忆 riotous，可以说 **a riotous crowd — “After a championship victory, an overexcited crowd may become riotous and difficult to control.”**

quiz.question: vacuous ______
quiz.explanation: 空洞的; 无意义的, 空洞的评论. His vacuous remark added nothing to the discussion. 他空洞的评论对讨论毫无帮助。 | vacu->空（拉丁vacuus），vacuous->空洞无物的（cf. vacuum真空，evacuate撤离=清空，vacant空缺，vacation假期=空闲） || 文化联想：中文“空话套话、毫无内容”最适合帮助记忆 vacuous，可以说 **a vacuous remark — “Saying ‘everything will somehow work out’ without any reasoning may be a vacuous remark.”**

quiz.question: conspicuous _______
quiz.explanation: 显眼的; 显著的, 显著的成功. The project was a conspicuous success for the team. 该项目对团队来说是显著的成功。 | con->加强，spic->看，conspicuous->非常显眼的（cf. perspicuous清晰，perspicacious洞察力强，inspect检查） || 文化联想：中文“成绩特别突出、非常显眼”最适合帮助记忆 conspicuous，可以说 **a conspicuous success — “A project that finishes early, under budget, and with excellent results becomes a conspicuous success.”**

quiz.question: perspicuous _____
quiz.explanation: 明晰的; 清楚的, 明晰的风格. The author wrote in a perspicuous style easy to understand. 作者以易于理解的明晰风格写作。 | per->穿透，spic->看，perspicuous->能看穿的=清晰明白的（cf. perspicacious洞察力强，conspicuous显眼，opaque不透明） || 文化联想：中文“表达清楚、一看就懂”最适合帮助记忆 perspicuous，可以说 **a perspicuous style — “A textbook written in short, precise sentences has a perspicuous style that helps beginners understand difficult ideas.”**

quiz.question: innocuous ______
quiz.explanation: 无害的; 无伤大雅的, 无伤大雅的评论. His innocuous remark was misinterpreted as criticism. 他无伤大雅的评论被误解为批评。 | in->无，noc->伤害（拉丁nocere），innocuous->无害的（cf. innocent无辜的，noxious有毒的，obnoxious讨厌的） || 文化联想：中文“无伤大雅”最适合帮助记忆 innocuous，可以说 **an innocuous remark — “A casual comment about the weather is usually an innocuous remark with no intention to offend.”**

quiz.question: deciduous ____
quiz.explanation: 落叶的, 落叶树. The deciduous tree loses its leaves every autumn. 落叶树每年秋天都会落叶。 | de->向下，cidu->落下（拉丁cadere），deciduous->每年落下的（cf. decay腐朽，cadence节奏=落下，accident意外=落下） || 文化联想：北京秋天银杏落叶最适合帮助记忆 deciduous，可以说 **a deciduous tree — “A ginkgo is a deciduous tree that turns yellow and drops its leaves in autumn.”**

quiz.question: assiduous _____
quiz.explanation: 勤勉的; 刻苦的, 勤勉的学习. Through assiduous study, he achieved excellent grades. 通过勤勉的学习,他取得了优异的成绩。 | as->朝向，sid->坐（拉丁sedere），assiduous->坐在旁边不离开=坚持不懈的（cf. sedulous勤勉，sedentary久坐的，session会议） || 文化联想：中文“勤学苦读”最适合帮助记忆 assiduous，可以说 **assiduous study — “A student who reviews lessons every day for years demonstrates assiduous study.”**

quiz.question: ambiguous _________
quiz.explanation: 含糊的; 模棱两可的, 含糊的陈述. The politicians ambiguous statement confused voters. 政客含糊的陈述让选民感到困惑。 | ambi->两者，ag->驱动（拉丁agere），ambiguous->可以向两个方向走=模棱两可的（cf. ambidextrous两手灵，ambivalent矛盾的） || 文化联想：中文“模棱两可”最适合帮助记忆 ambiguous，可以说 **an ambiguous statement — “A statement that can reasonably be understood in two different ways is ambiguous—也就是‘模棱两可.’”**

quiz.question: contiguous ______
quiz.explanation: 毗连的; 接壤的, 接壤的州. The forty-eight contiguous states form the mainland USA. 四十八个接壤的州构成了美国大陆。 | con->共同，tig->触摸（拉丁tangere），contiguous->共同接触的=毗连的（cf. tangible可触的，contagious传染，contact接触） || 文化联想：中国地图上彼此接壤的省份最适合帮助记忆 contiguous，可以说 **contiguous provinces — “Two provinces that share a continuous land boundary are contiguous regions.”**

quiz.question: exiguous _________
quiz.explanation: 稀少的; 贫乏的, 稀少的资源. The expedition survived on exiguous resources. 探险队靠稀少的资源生存。 | exig->驱出（拉丁exigere->要求/衡量），exiguous->被要求到所剩无几的=稀少的（cf. exact精确，examine检查，exigent紧迫的） || 文化联想：中文“资源少得可怜”最适合帮助记忆 exiguous，可以说 **exiguous resources — “A remote research team may have to complete its work with exiguous resources and very little equipment.”**

quiz.question: mellifluous _____
quiz.explanation: 甜美的; 悦耳的, 甜美的声音. The singers mellifluous voice captivated the audience. 歌手甜美的声音吸引了观众。 | melli->蜂蜜（拉丁mel），flu->流动，mellifluous->像蜂蜜一样流淌的=甜美的（cf. honey蜂蜜，fluid流体，mead蜂蜜酒） || 文化联想：中文“嗓音像蜂蜜一样顺滑悦耳”最适合帮助记忆 mellifluous，可以说 **a mellifluous voice — “A singer with a smooth, flowing tone may have a mellifluous voice that listeners find soothing.”**

quiz.question: superfluous _______
quiz.explanation: 多余的; 过剩的, 多余的细节. The editor removed superfluous details from the manuscript. 编辑从稿件中删除了多余的细节。 | super->超过，flu->流动，superfluous->溢出流走的多余部分（cf. fluid流体，fluent流利，influence影响=流入） || 文化联想：中文“画蛇添足”最适合帮助记忆 superfluous，可以说 **superfluous details — “Adding unnecessary explanations after a point is already clear can create superfluous details—很像‘画蛇添足.’”**

quiz.question: ingenuous _____
quiz.explanation: 天真的; 坦率的, 天真的微笑. Her ingenuous smile revealed her honest nature. 她天真的微笑显示了她诚实的本性。 | in->天生，gen->产生（拉丁），ingenuous->天生不加掩饰的=天真坦率的（cf. ingenious巧妙的，ingenue天真少女，disingenuous不坦率的） || 文化联想：中文“天真坦率、不设防”最适合帮助记忆 ingenuous，可以说 **an ingenuous smile — “A child who smiles openly without calculation may have an ingenuous smile.”**

quiz.question: tenuous ____
quiz.explanation: 脆弱的; 微弱的, 微弱的联系. The evidence showed only a tenuous link between the suspects. 证据只显示嫌疑人之间有微弱的联系。 | ten->细/薄（拉丁tenuis），tenuous->细薄微弱的（cf. thin薄，tend趋向，attenuate使衰减，tenor持续） || 文化联想：中文“牵强、联系很弱”最适合帮助记忆 tenuous，可以说 **a tenuous link — “Two events that merely happened in the same month may have only a tenuous link.”**

quiz.question: sinuous ____
quiz.explanation: 蜿蜒的; 曲折的, 蜿蜒的小路. The sinuous path wound through the forest. 蜿蜒的小路穿过森林。 | sin->弯曲（拉丁sinus->弯曲/海湾），sinuous->弯弯曲曲的=蜿蜒的（cf. sinus鼻窦，insinuate暗示=蜿蜒进入，sine正弦） || 文化联想：九寨沟或武夷山蜿蜒山路最适合帮助记忆 sinuous，可以说 **a sinuous path — “A mountain trail may follow a sinuous path that curves repeatedly around cliffs and streams.”**

quiz.question: congruous _____
quiz.explanation: 一致的; 适合的, 一致的风格. The furniture was congruous style with the rooms design. 家具与房间的设计风格一致。 | con->共同，gru->走（拉丁gradi），congruous->共同走向的=一致的（cf. congruent全等，incongruous不协调，congress共同行走） || 文化联想：中文“风格协调一致”最适合帮助记忆 congruous，可以说 **a congruous style — “Traditional wooden furniture can look congruous in a room designed with restrained Chinese decorative elements.”**

quiz.question: fatuous ______
quiz.explanation: 愚蠢的; 愚昧的, 愚蠢的评论. His fatuous remark showed complete ignorance of the subject. 他愚蠢的评论显示了对该主题的完全无知。 | fatu->愚蠢（拉丁fatuus），fatuous->愚蠢可笑的（cf. infatuate使迷恋=使愚蠢，fatuous vs. stupid程度更强） || 文化联想：中文“愚不可及的说法”最适合帮助记忆 fatuous，可以说 **a fatuous remark — “Claiming that preparation never matters because luck decides everything is a fatuous remark.”**

quiz.question: impetuous ________
quiz.explanation: 冲动的; 鲁莽的, 冲动的决定. Her impetuous decision led to regrettable consequences. 她冲动的决定导致了令人遗憾的后果。 | im->进入，pet->冲（拉丁petere->冲向），impetuous->猛冲而不考虑的=冲动的（cf. impetus动力，petition请求，compete竞争） || 文化联想：中文“头脑一热就做决定”最适合帮助记忆 impetuous，可以说 **an impetuous decision — “Buying an expensive car immediately after seeing an advertisement can be an impetuous decision.”**

quiz.question: voluptuous ______
quiz.explanation: 性感的; 丰满的, 性感的身材. The model was known for her voluptuous figure. 这位模特以其性感的身材而闻名。 | volupt->感官享受（拉丁voluptas->快乐），voluptuous->丰满感性的（cf. voluptuary享乐者，sensual感官的） || 文化联想：唐代仕女画中丰润的审美形象最适合帮助记忆 voluptuous，可以说 **a voluptuous figure — “A painting inspired by Tang court aesthetics may portray a graceful, voluptuous figure with rounded forms.”**

quiz.question: virtuous ______
quiz.explanation: 有道德的; 良性的, 良性循环. Education creates a virtuous circle of opportunity. 教育创造了一个良性循环的机会。 | virt->美德（拉丁virtus->力量），virtuous->有美德的（cf. virtue美德，virtual实际上的，virtuoso大师，virile男性的） || 文化联想：中文“良性循环”最适合帮助记忆 virtuous，可以说 **a virtuous circle — “Better education can raise incomes, which then supports more investment in education, creating a virtuous circle.”**

quiz.question: tortuous ____
quiz.explanation: 曲折的; 复杂的, 曲折的道路. They followed a tortuous path up the mountain. 他们沿着曲折的道路爬上山。 | tort->扭曲（拉丁torquere），tortuous->扭曲弯折的（cf. torture折磨=扭曲，distort扭曲，extort敲诈，retort反驳=扭回去） || 文化联想：中国山路九曲十八弯最适合帮助记忆 tortuous，可以说 **a tortuous path — “A road climbing through steep mountains may follow a tortuous path with repeated sharp bends.”**
